claims.identified: Bulbapedia, Holofoil: "Line Holofoil was used for standard Holo cards from Sword & Shield through Crown Zenith. The pattern consists of thin vertical lines that refract light from the top to the bottom of the Pokémon's image. Japanese cards using the pattern also have Holofoil borders, while international releases retained their yellow borders."
claims.limitation: The pitch (8px, 128 lines), the ridge width and the depth of the top-to-bottom drift are this build's drawing: the source names the orientation and the fineness of the lines, not a count. The paper is identified at the SET level — no printing record claims a Line card — and Japanese printings' foil borders are not modelled because this catalogue holds English rows.

sheet.tiling: disclosed choice: pitch divides the sheet, seam measured
sheet.description: thin vertical ridges that refract light top to bottom
